name: SAPS Emergency & Crime Stop
description: Immediate police response if you or someone near you is in physical danger, witnessing violence, or facing a life-threatening emergency.

name: SADAG Suicide Crisis Line
description: Confidential telephonic counselling with trained counsellors for suicidal thoughts, severe panic, depression, or overwhelming emotional pain.
whoItHelps: Anyone feeling hopeless, overwhelmed, or thinking of self-harm

name: Dept. of Social Development Substance Abuse Helpline
description: National helpline connecting individuals and worried family members to local social workers, public rehab clinics, and detox support across all 9 provinces.
whoItHelps: People struggling with nyaope, tik, alcohol, dagga, and their families

name: GBV Command Centre
description: Trained social workers providing immediate crisis support, safety planning, and shelter referrals for anyone experiencing domestic or gender-based violence.
whoItHelps: Survivors of abuse, domestic violence, or assault

name: Childline South Africa
description: Safe, free counselling for children, teenagers, and youth facing abuse, neglect, bullying, gang pressure, or trouble at home.
whoItHelps: Children, teens, and young people under 18 (and concerned adults)

name: LifeLine South Africa
description: Confidential trauma and emotional crisis counselling with community-based counsellors in multiple South African languages.
whoItHelps: Youth and adults facing trauma, grief, or crisis

name: SANCA National (Substance Abuse)
description: South African National Council on Alcoholism and Drug Dependence offering outpatient counselling, youth prevention, and family support groups.
whoItHelps: Individuals seeking recovery & families needing guidance

name: Narcotics Anonymous South Africa
description: Peer-led recovery community where people trying to stay clean support each other in person and online without judgement.
whoItHelps: Anyone wanting to stop using drugs, one day at a time

name: Legal Aid South Africa
description: Free legal representation and rights advice for youth and adults who cannot afford a private lawyer, including diversion programmes for young offenders.
whoItHelps: Youth and families navigating criminal charges or court
